summary: - **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — [#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663) fixes a longstanding multi-threading correctness issue in `Geant4OutputAction`: run and file parameters ingested during simulation now correctly land in the output for both EDM4hep and LCIO writers, addressing [#1660](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/issues/1660) where previously one run was written per thread. [#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666) adds a new `kUpstreamTrapezoid` mask type in `Mask_o1_v01_geo.cpp` to handle non-cylindrically symmetric FCC MDI synchrotron radiation masks (paired with k4geo [#648](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/648)). [#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681) removes the CSG-based ASSIMP CAD exporter because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private — this is a functionality regression that will be restored via a follow-up (#1682) using only public ROOT APIs.

- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — [#658](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658) introduces `MuSIC_v3`, a substantially updated Muon Collider detector geometry: each nozzle is now instrumented with three silicon disks forming a Forward Tracker, vertex barrel/endcap layers have been reduced (with corrected layer IDs), and the yoke iron is removed in favour of the HCAL barrel acting as the magnetic flux return; v3 was cleaned up to reuse unchanged v2 subsystems rather than duplicate files. [#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662) maps geometry volumes to their nearest predefined ROOT colour, improving visual consistency of geometry displays.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — [#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524) hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, which was silently selecting the wrong overload in Python bindings (fixes [#523](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/issues/523)). A workaround until the deprecated method is removed entirely.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — [#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431) adds a `--evt-max` alias to `k4run` matching Gaudi's `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`, making the event-limit option more discoverable (note: the CLI value still overrides steering-file settings). [#427](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/427) modernises test components to use functional algorithms, replacing legacy ROOT-file and Marlin-wrapper producers and consolidating CellID metadata validation.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — [#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98), [#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/102) and [#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104) adapt to several breaking ACTS API changes (propagator and grid-bin finder rework in acts-project/acts#6004, deprecated material-binning APIs replaced with `AxisSpec`, and support for the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct from acts-project/acts#6123). As discussed by maintainers, this may temporarily break builds against older tagged ACTS versions in downstream release-based workflows. [#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97) also makes `--compactFile` required in the CKF, GNN and geometry-visualisation option scripts, replacing a cryptic Gaudi `TypeError` with a clean argparse error.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora)** — [#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54) fixes PFO comparison to be compatible with the current EDM4hep interface after [EDM4hep#520](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/520).

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — [#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386) extends the tracking-validation option (`--addTruthTracks`, `--runTrkValidation`) to the IDEA full-simulation digitisation/reconstruction steering and exposes the switch through the IDEA and ALLEGRO ctest wrappers, building on the earlier ALLEGRO work in #379.

- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — [#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15) shrinks child volumes overlapping their parents so nested detector volumes render as distinct in the glTF output, reduces `numFaces` default to 1000, bumps default transparency to 100%, and cleans up conversion logic and configuration constants — noticeable improvements for FCC geometry visualisation of ALLEGRO, CLD and IDEA models.
